questions.stem: A 7-year-old child from a region with known iodine deficiency presents to the clinic with symptoms including developmental delay, short stature, and coarse facial features. The child’s parents report a high prevalence of goiter in their community. To prevent similar cases in the future, which of the following preventive measures is the most appropriate?

options.label: A
options.text: Prescribing high-dose thyroid hormone replacement therapy

options.label: B
options.text: Recommending the use of iodinated salt or iodized oil

options.label: C
options.text: Advising on a diet high in vegetables and fruits

options.label: D
options.text: Performing regular thyroid function tests for all community members
